Messages.Author: Stubby
Messages.Body:
can you use this at any stage during a game?

this arose during a game:

player one: minion had laptop, tasha on him. finishes go. heidleberg
not tapped at this stage.

player two: plays haven uncovered on minion.

player one: taps the heidleberg to move equipment before player two
beats hell of the minion.

was this legal?

if so does this also mean you can do it mid-combat? etc etc.

stubby

(aka Ian: as in anam's other half)

Messages.Author: Richard Zopf
Messages.Body:
Stubby wrote in message <37e66bb9...@nntp.netcom.net.uk>...

>can you use this at any stage during a game?
>
>this arose during a game:
>
>player one: minion had laptop, tasha on him. finishes go. heidleberg
>not tapped at this stage.
>
>player two: plays haven uncovered on minion.
>
>player one: taps the heidleberg to move equipment before player two
>beats hell of the minion.
>
>was this legal?

Yep.

>
>if so does this also mean you can do it mid-combat? etc etc.
>

No. You can't Heidelburg mid-action. You do, however, have an opportunity
to use it between actions. This would include the period in player 2's turn
after his master phase, but before he declares his first action.

Regards,
